doctrine_ref: Intent gate clause-local negation scope (2026-10-25 fix): negation governs its own clause only. A whole-prefix check negates a later real verb with an earlier clause's don't.
rationale: The first clause refuses (photos), the second clause requests (account). Clause-local scope must skip the negated verb and count the real one: the ACTIVE profile is a finding, deletion is the remediation, absence is the verification. A whole-sentence negation reading would wrongly clear a dirty account.
request_summary: Synthetic subject says: Don't delete my photos, delete my account. The account profile is ACTIVE.
title: Mixed sentence: negated clause plus real deletion clause
